question: In a certain code language, 'RAUGHT' is written as 'TYWEJR' and 'DOMINE' is written as 'FMOGPC'. How will 'BACKER' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

'RAUGHT' is written as 'TYWEJR'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0a0ef80346224062cf9263d69afff489d09b8a04512db2f2d2974482d95ab63.png] 

and

'DOMINE' is written as 'FMOGPC'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea36f689b4392ee8d8e0d9ea844b8fc96df3695f4caedb09deb1be3651ebc3ee.png] 

Similarly,

'BACKER' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/515f090312942fe4b43e3ccf34a6caaeb697e9034c9e065a7954c2c018d34684.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"DYEIGP".**
